brands.name: Vibia
brands.advisory_note: The architect's choice: light as part of the structure.

products.description: Textile/cable system to 'draw' light across a space, for large volumes and high ceilings.
Airy 3D outline made of black electrical cables with LED terminals. Works over tables and in double-height spaces.
Cloud of globes that defines zones inside large interiors.
Layered translucent diffusers, slender silhouettes for high ceilings.
Modern take on the 19th-century bouillotte lamp, diffuse downward light.
Adjustable triangular carbon-fibre rods holding the shades.
Minimal conductive bar with balanced elements. A toolkit of diffuse and accent light.
Textured, tactile diffuser that gives a warm, soft light.
Lighting composition that can integrate plants. Good for biophilic projects.
Blown-glass archetypes (disc, diamond, milk-glass oval) in two sizes.
Delicate silhouette inspired by nature.
Glass panel lit by a row of recessed LEDs, light appears to float in the glass.
Small decorative object lamp.
Toolkit for integrating light into architecture.
Discreet ceiling accents, trim or trimless, also in wood finishes.

brands.name: a·emotional light
brands.advisory_note: When the luminaire should be the protagonist and give the space a soul. Note: no a·emotional catalogue in the voice agent's knowledge base, so product details are limited.

brands.name: LZF Lamps
brands.advisory_note: Warm, natural, FSC wood. Pairs well with biophilia projects.

products.description: Concentric wood-veneer petals forming a flower of light.
Twisting sculptural form made from a flat sheet of wood veneer.
Modular wood-veneer pendant. Link Chain builds vertical or horizontal configurations to measure.
Rhythmic metal and wood-veneer arches, extendable composition. Homage to Oscar Niemeyer.
Hanging garden of lamps and golden birds combining several LZF icons.
Linear lamp inspired by piano keys, two independently controlled circuits.
Wood-veneer suspension.
Pebble-shaped lamps in small, medium and large.
Portable rechargeable lamp.
Raw-ceramic lamp echoing modular apartment blocks.

brands.name: Olé Lighting
brands.advisory_note: The problem solver when a project needs a custom fit without luxury pricing.

products.description: Linear luminaire combined with acoustic material. Light and sound comfort in one piece.
Truncated-cone shade with organic texture and warm diffused glow.
Handcrafted braided double cone in sustainable cord, many colours.
Jellyfish-inspired shape in two versions.
Customisable with metal or cord shades.
Minimal aluminium and polycarbonate 'chalk strokes' with LED, many combinations.
Creates a luminous ring on the ceiling. Corridors, kitchens, bathrooms.
Traditional lantern shape with modern LED, textured metal frame.
Several versions (Pop, Twist, Plus).

products.collection: Banyo / Pot / Drum / Pagoda / Polaris / Morgana / Pepo
products.description: Cord and metal collections in many sizes and colours.

brands.name: Roger Pradier
brands.advisory_note: The safe bet outdoors. Confirm IP rating and warranty before quoting.

products.description: Inspired by a primitive hut: a glass casing around the light source.
Classic lantern style for heritage façades.

comparison: Vibia = architectural and integrated. a·emotional = sculptural. LZF = warm wood. Olé = flexible and custom. Roger Pradier = outdoor durability.
